title: Flax and Honey Banana Bread
blurb: A moist, naturally sweetened loaf made with flaxseed meal and ripe bananas. Simple to mix and bake, with a gentle sweetness from honey.
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C and grease a 900g loaf tin with a little oil.
Peel the bananas and mash them thoroughly in a large bowl with a fork until fairly smooth.
Add the soya milk, honey and oil to the mashed banana and stir until combined.
Put the flaxseed meal and baking powder into the bowl and mix everything together until you have a thick, even batter.
Pour the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top with a spoon.
Bake for 55 minutes until the loaf is firm to the touch and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Leave the bread to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.
